A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OHSVGP research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite reorganization and redrawing.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E report original online prediction, continual-learning, runtime, and synthetic-data experiments.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix F retain original empirical results, including time-series prediction, continual learning, runtime comparisons, and synthetic examples.

M1.justification: The written OHSVGP-k selection rule changes from argmin k to argmax k, and the optional direct-covariance ODE changes sign in Eq. 20. These are limited corrections to specified procedures; the main HiPPO/RFF construction and variational objectives remain.

E1.justification: Both versions use Solar Irradiance, Audio, COVID death counts, Skillcraft, Powerplant, ERA5, Two-moon classification, and synthetic time-series examples. No dataset, domain, or distinct evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators, including OSVGP/OSGPR, OVC, OVC-optZ, OVFF, OVC-per-dim, and the COVID AR(2) renewal model. The sorting variants remain after matching their corrected names.

E3.justification: Section 5.2 revises the reported within-task ordering for OHSVGP-k from minimizing kernel values to maximizing kernel similarity. This changes the stated experimental setting without establishing reruns. Splits, metrics, inducing-variable counts, and training budgets otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The trainable-kernel experiments, Two-moon sorting study, and HiPPO basis–measure comparisons remain in v3 Appendix E.2–E.4 and v4 Appendix F.2–F.4. The sorting-label corrections reuse the same decision-boundary evidence; no additional ablation or robustness experiment appears.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and 95% confidence intervals from five independent runs, or three for ERA5. Predictive uncertainty conventions and the ECE sampling specification are retained. Changed confidence-band display widths do not introduce a new statistical procedure.

E6.justification: Table 1 runtimes, main result plots, and appendix performance trajectories retain their values. The redrawn UCI and ERA5 plots preserve means and interval endpoints. Two-moon boundaries and accuracy findings are retained after matching the min/max variants across the distance-to-similarity naming correction.

T1.justification: Appendix B expands Eq. 19 to include further lower-order terms, corrects the leading sign in Eq. 20, and adds a Lyapunov-operator spectral argument in B.2.2. Section 3.2 changes reconstruction from weighted phi functions to g polynomials, although Appendix C retains the old expression.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about HiPPO interdomain inducing variables, recurrent covariance updates, long-term memory, predictive performance, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: New Appendix B.2.2 offers a stiffness and conditioning explanation for the direct covariance ODE's instability, contrasting Lyapunov eigenvalue sums with the RFF evolution's eigenvalues. v3 reports the instability without this explanation. Existing applicability and forgetting discussions remain.

D1.justification: v4 adds a source-code pointer on the first page and Appendix E with single-task and online ELBO pseudocode, including covariance-evolution intervals. These improve procedural documentation without establishing changed implementations. Hardware and hyperparameter disclosures are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: v4 adds Horn and Johnson (1991) for the spectral argument and Kingma and Welling (2014), correcting the VAE attribution previously given to the Adam paper. The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized explanations expand Sections 2.4 and 3.3 and Appendix B. A new algorithm appendix shifts Additional Results from E to F, sorting terminology is corrected, and the publication header changes. Most prose and the main section sequence remain stable.

P2.justification: The appendix substantially redesigns retained results: v3's two landscape UCI figures become four portrait figures, and ERA5 plots are reorganized into larger grids. Axes, legends, markers, and interval displays change. v4 also adds two algorithm displays and corrects the Two-moon panel labels.

improvement.justification: v4 clarifies sorting, corrects some covariance mathematics, adds a code pointer, and makes appendix plots easier to read. However, new Algorithm 2, lines 5–6, omits covariance inverses required by Eq. 2, undermining its reproducibility value. The reconstruction correction also remains inconsistent with Appendix C. These competing accessibility gains and mathematical inconsistencies prevent a confident net-quality judgment.
